description: EC degraded-data Phase 1 replay fixture (PLANNING_ec_degraded_data_phase1.md §7). Built 2026-10-04 from a read-only extract of the HA recorder (ssh ha, /config/home-assistant_v2.db opened mode=ro). Values are recorder rows verbatim; nothing hand-edited.

provenance.query: states JOIN states_meta (+ state_attributes) per entity: the as-of row strictly before window start, then every row with window_start <= last_updated_ts <= window_end.
provenance.row_shape: [state, last_updated_iso, last_reported_iso_or_null, unit_of_measurement_or_null]; last_reported null in the recorder means == last_updated.
provenance.strategy_oracle_shape: [t_iso, soc_source, arbitrage_phase, soc] from sensor.ura_energy_coordinator_battery_strategy attrs (rows where any of the three changed).
provenance.known_recorder_limit: The recorder does not persist last_reported-only refreshes of an unchanged value (e.g. native SOC flat 10% from 03:23:53Z to 05:42:10Z while the live strategy reported soc_source=envoy at 05:29:29Z). Replay therefore reconstructs native-Envoy freshness as 'numeric as-of row = reporting now' and checks the reconstruction against the strategy oracle.
